text:
customer-rep: Escalation from Acme (AC-992). They report streaming responses truncating right after a reconnect and seeing double billing for the last few tokens. Sending logs. @sara can you triage?

sara: On it. Can you paste the minimal repro + env (SDK + version, runtime browser/Node, any proxies)?

customer-rep: Using JS SDK v2.3.1 in Node (Lambda). They use an EventSource polyfill. Steps: start stream -> after ~3s upstream rotates token -> client reconnects automatically -> client receives a truncated JSON fragment as final frame, then later gets another delta that looks like a replay (counts as extra tokens). Logs: 
```
[2024-08-07T12:03:14Z] conn open
[2024-08-07T12:03:17Z] token rotate -> 401 returned, client reconnect
[2024-08-07T12:03:18Z] sse: data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"...\n\n"}}, {"delta":{"content":"\""}}] }
```
Seems last frame got cut mid-JSON.

support-bot: Created internal bug tracking: BUG-4892 (stream-frame-truncation-on-reconnect).

mike: Looking at logs, I see the final frame often ends with a partial chunk: `..."],"id":` and then connection close. That matches a framing/flush issue where we close socket before sending trailing bytes.

jamie: Could be related to the heartbeat/close change from PR #1882 (server: flush-on-heartbeat). I can try a small local repro harness that simulates token rotation + EventSource resume.

jamie: Repro script (Node/EventSource polyfill):
```
const EventSource = require('eventsource');
const es = new EventSource('https://api.redwood/infer/stream?model=x', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer OLD' }});
es.onmessage = (e) => console.log('msg', e.data);
setTimeout(() => rotateTokenAndReconnect(es), 3000);
function rotateTokenAndReconnect(es) { /* simulate 401 then reconnect with NEW token */ }
```

sara: Running jamie's harness now in a container with same SDK version — I repro in ~30s. Observed behavior: client reconnects, the old connection emits a final heartbeat but the last SSE data frame is split across packets; the new connection resumes but kvcache offsets don't match, so the client sees an incomplete JSON chunk and then a replayed delta that looks like duplicate tokens.

mike: Temporary mitigation for customers: bump client resume backoff to 500ms and coalesce small frames in the SDK before JSON.parse (buffer until we see a closing brace or newline). That reduces dup counts. I'll prepare a snippet for support teams.

customer-rep: Customer applied backoff and saw fewer duplicates but still occasional truncation under high concurrency. They're sensitive because of billing impact.

jamie: Plan: (1) reproduce deterministically in lab with concurrent reconnects + token rotation, (2) if repro, either revert PR #1882 or implement server-side flush of pending SSE frames before connection close, and add kvcache resync handshake to avoid replaying deltas. I'll open BUG-4892 with steps and attach logs.

eng-oncall: Assigning to eng-runtime (pinging @mike @jamie). We'll run a canary with a frame-flush patch and monitor for regressions. I'll update AC-992 and the customer thread when the canary is live. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Noted follow-up: will add a temporary KB article for affected customers recommending backoff + SDK patch.

sara: Thanks — keeping this thread for updates. If we get a deterministic repro harness, drop it here and I'll run it against canary infra.
